g.title: TI TMDS62LEVM Rev. B schematic sheet 03 — altiumts source

g.text: Initial Draft derived from AM62P SK - PROC164E1-1 schematics
Replaced parts : LPDDR4 (2 GB), Updated FT4232 UART section
Updated power section & PMIC part as per PDN
Added ADC header, MCAN headers & updated respective net connections
Updated SoC RTC and SoC Reset section

text.tspan: - Updated PMIC 1 and PMIC 2 connections
- Updated PMIC local caps, GPIO connections & assembly
- Added U81 Buck regulator for 2V5 supply
- Removed load switch and added AND gate for the enable logic 3V3 and 5V0

g.text: Implemented Internal review comments and shared to TI for Review

text.tspan: - Changed the value of shunt resistor R426 to 0.02E
- Changed the values of shunt resistors R164, R4034 to

g.text: Replaced QSPI NAND flash with new part

text.tspan: - Added 0 ohm series resistor to QSPI data lines
- Added 2 push buttons for PMIC nWAKEUP logic
- Added current monitor for VDDACORE power
Updated decaps of PMIC 1 and PMIC 2
- Changed Assembly instruction for R124, C487 & C489 to
Mount
- C481 value has been changed from 0.1uF to 1uF
- Added RC circuit for I2C2_SCL and I2C2_SDA
- R169, R210, R217 has been DNI'd
- Changed Assembly instruction for R215 and R209 to
- PORz (Power ON reset) logic has been changed
- Values of Current sense resistors have been
- Input power supply of VDD_RTC and VDDS_RTC_1V8 LDO's has been changed to VCC_3V3_MAIN
- RTC mode selection header connections has been updated

g.text: Implemented Modular approach and shared to TI for the review
Updated Block diagrams and ADC header

text.tspan: - 1x3 headers (J16, J6, J18) of MCAN have been replaced with 1x4
headers

g.text: The schematics has been Back annotated

text.tspan: - All the D-Notes and CAD Notes have been updated
- Block diagrams have been updated
- Shunt resistor R3969, R3968 have been placed between J35 and SOC
pin
- Added new connections for No RTC mode in J35 - 5x3
Header
- Added GPIO expansion connector
- The enable logic of Bootmode buffers U111, U114 & U110 have been changed by
connecting one of the output of IO Expander to U23 AND gate.
- PMIC-2 (U50) and its corresponding inductors and capacitors were mounted as TPS65214x
PMIC
will be using as primary PMIC for the production build.
J25 and J26 1x2 headers have been added to EXP_PS_3V3_EN and EXP_PS_5V0_EN signals
respectively to provide option to select default state of U2 and U4 load switch
- J27 & J28 1x2 headers have been added to have the option to short the shunt resistor on
VDD_RTC (R505) and VDDS_RTC (R516). These two jumpers are DNI'd
- SMD TP's are added across the shunt resistor on VDD_RTC (R505) and VDDS_RTC (R516)
- For the INA devices, supply has been replaced with VCC_3V3_MAIN instead of VCC_3V3_SYS.
- Added level shifter U134 for SoC_I2C1_SDA/SCL between SoC & INA devices for shiting IO
level
between VCC_3V3_SYS and VCC_3V3_MAIN

g.text: Updated R497 to be mounted with a 0ohm resistor and R154 to be DNI.
